COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 25, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Zoe Nicholson, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Maleka Lassiter, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner
Sathya Chey Patterson, Commissioner

  COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS IN-PERSON MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO ALANAH.GRANT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 994 2442 7353
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/99424427353

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54977  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, August 28, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54978  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from The Long Beach Human
  Trafficking Task Force on their services and advocacy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54979  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the City Attorney’s Office
  regarding the advisory authority of the Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54650  Recommendation to receive and file updates from the Office of Equity.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54980  Recommendation to adopt Community Agreements for Commission meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-54981  Recommendation to adopt a time certain, establishing meeting operating hours as
  6:30 PM-8:30 PM, with the option to extend meetings as necessary by a vote of the
  Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact he Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
